title: Engine Fire Handle — Detent Break-Out Force Check and Guard Inspection
abstract: Break-out force check of the engine fire handle detent and inspection of the hinged guard, with the microswitch actuation check that confirms the switch makes only at full pull.

sections.purpose: This task gives the detent break-out force check of an engine fire handle, the inspection of the hinged guard and its hinge, and the microswitch actuation check that confirms the switch makes only when the handle is fully pulled.
sections.job_setup_note: The fire extinguishing bottles must be isolated before any handle is pulled, because the check requires the handle to be moved through its full travel. All four handles are checked in the same visit; a mixed set is not permitted and finding one out of limits means all four are re-checked. The break-out force gauge must be applied on the handle centre line, since an off-centre pull gives a low reading.
sections.procedure: 1. Isolate the fire extinguishing bottles and put the warning notice in position. WARNING: CONFIRM THE BOTTLES ARE ISOLATED BEFORE ANY HANDLE IS PULLED. A HANDLE PULLED WITH THE BOTTLES ARMED DISCHARGES THE AGENT. 2. Confirm the aircraft is on ground power and that the engines have not run in the last hour. 3. Examine the hinged guard for cracking, and check the hinge for free movement and for the correct spring return. 4. Lift the guard and confirm it stays clear without being held. 5. Fit the break-out force gauge on the handle centre line. CAUTION: APPLY THE GAUGE ON THE CENTRE LINE. AN OFF-CENTRE PULL GIVES A LOW READING AND A HANDLE THAT IS ACTUALLY OUT OF LIMITS WILL PASS. 6. Pull slowly and record the force at which the detent breaks out. 7. Confirm the handle latches fully and that no stable intermediate position exists. 8. Check the microswitch actuation point and confirm the switch makes only at full pull. 9. Confirm the guard has fallen clear and does not obstruct the pulled handle. 10. Return the handle to the stowed position and confirm the detent re-engages. 11. Repeat for the remaining three handles. 12. Restore the fire extinguishing bottles.
sections.close_out: Remove the warning notice and confirm that all four handles are stowed with the guards closed. Record the four measured break-out forces and the microswitch actuation results in the aircraft maintenance record. Report any handle outside the limits before the aircraft is released; a single out-of-limit handle requires all four to be re-checked.

type_data.effectivity_note: Aircraft post MOD-148940 only. On earlier aircraft the guard steps do not apply and the handle travel check in the previous issue is used.

safety_precautions: Isolate the fire extinguishing bottles before any handle is pulled.
Confirm the engines have not run in the last hour.
Put the warning notice in position.
